title: National Career Service — Pan-India Job Search Portal
description: Official Ministry of Labour & Employment portal to search and apply for verified private and public sector job openings, career fairs, and state employment exchanges across India.
provider_name: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India

eligibility.notes: Open across qualification levels (10th pass to postgraduate); candidates register with Aadhaar/NCS ID.

provenance_notes: Official portal search directory link for NCS jobseeker services. Represents a trusted search directory, not an individual job vacancy.

title: Apprenticeship India — Designated Trade Opportunity Directory
description: Official national directory to discover industry apprenticeships with registered enterprises under the Apprentices Act and National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS).
provider_name: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) / NAPS

eligibility.notes: Candidates with ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, or Vocational qualifications in designated trades.

provenance_notes: Official directory destination for searching active enterprise apprenticeships across states.

title: Prime Minister's Internship Scheme (PMIS) — Official Portal
description: Central government application portal for candidates applying to 12-month corporate internships in top 500 partner enterprises under Ministry of Corporate Affairs guidelines.
provider_name: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India

eligibility.qualification: Passed 10th, 12th, ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, or Graduate degree.

provenance_notes: Central government internship portal search destination. Stipend details apply to specific matched company listings under the scheme.

title: Skill India Digital Hub — Free Courses Directory
description: Explore all officially listed free online vocational, technological, and foundational courses certified by NSDC.
provider_name: NSDC / Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
provenance_notes: Official search directory destination for NSDC zero-cost online courses.

title: SWAYAM — Course Search & Enrolment Directory
description: Explore national higher education and engineering courses delivered by IITs, IIMs, and central universities with academic credit transfer options.
provider_name: Ministry of Education, Government of India

eligibility.notes: Open enrolment; academic credits require registered proctored examination.

provenance_notes: National MOOC directory search link. All course contents are free to audit.

title: Unlocking AI for Everyone
description: Foundational 45-minute self-paced module on core artificial intelligence concepts, responsible AI practices, and everyday productivity use-cases. Delivered by Microsoft on Skill India Digital Hub.
provenance_notes: Verified individual listing on SIDH. Delivered by Microsoft. Confirmed free of cost with self-paced 45-minute duration. General AI literacy awareness; does not certify programming skills.

title: Generative AI
description: Applied industry skilling program featuring 60 hours of theory and 30 hours of practical laboratory learning covering prompt engineering, LLM architectures, and AI application development with Python.

eligibility.prerequisites: Basic programming fundamentals (Python recommended) and understanding of web data structures.

provenance_notes: Verified partner program on SWAYAM Plus portal. Commercial provider SmartBridge; verified fee of ₹5,999 for 90 learning hours. Not a free government course.

title: Database Management System (DBMS) — NPTEL (Jul–Sep 2026 Run - Concluded)
description: 8-week NPTEL computer science curriculum by IIT Kharagpur covering relational algebra, standard SQL (DDL/DML), schema normalization, indexing, transaction processing, and concurrency control. Enrollment and exam registration cycle has concluded.

eligibility.prerequisites: Basic data structures and discrete mathematics.

provenance_notes: Official NPTEL/IIT Kharagpur course cycle. The scheduled Jul-Sep 2026 examination and active enrollment window has closed. Marked as closed/stale; archive lecture videos remain accessible on SWAYAM/YouTube.

title: Database Management System (DBMS) — NPTEL (Self-Paced Archive Reference)
description: Archived academic video lecture repository and syllabus reference for NPTEL DBMS (IIT Kharagpur). Available for open self-paced learning on SWAYAM; proctored exam registration not included in archive auditing.

eligibility.prerequisites: Basic data structures and discrete mathematics.

provenance_notes: Evergreen self-paced curriculum reference for DBMS. Does not represent a scheduled proctored exam cohort.

title: Frontend Web Development: Modern UI (Unconfirmed)
description: Frontend web development module covering HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and React. Unconfirmed listing pending confirmation of exact official SIDH course page.
provider_name: Skill India Digital Hub Partner Skilling

eligibility.prerequisites: Basic computer literacy and logical problem solving.

provenance_notes: Unconfirmed listing. The specific course URL on Skill India Digital Hub is not confirmed; points to generic portal search root. Excluded from verified individual recommendations pending direct URL verification.

title: Prime Minister's Internship Scheme (PMIS) — Scheme Framework & Stipend Guidelines
description: Central Government scheme guidelines providing 12-month corporate internships with top 500 partner enterprises under Ministry of Corporate Affairs regulations. Establishes ₹5,000 monthly stipend co-funded by Central Government DBT and partner CSR funds, plus ₹6,000 contingency grant. Specific internship vacancies must be searched and applied for via registered corporate profiles on the PMIS portal.
provider_name: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India

eligibility.qualification: Passed 10th, 12th, ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, or Graduate (BA, BSc, BCom, BCA, BBA, BPharma).
eligibility.exclusions: Graduates from IITs, IIMs, IISERs, CA/CMA, or family member employed in permanent government service are not eligible.

provenance_notes: Official Government scheme framework under MCA. Details scheme-level stipend rules (₹5,000/month). Does not represent a single employer vacancy; applications for active employer slots occur through partner corporate listings on pminternship.mca.gov.in.

title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme: Electronics & Instrumentation Testing (Curriculum Standard)
description: Designated trade qualification specification and training standard under NAPS. Establishes training duration and recommended stipend band (₹8,000-₹12,000/month). Specific enterprise vacancies are posted by participating employers on the Apprenticeship India portal.

eligibility.min_education: ITI in Electronics Mechanic / Diploma in Electronics Engineering

provenance_notes: NAPS curriculum and designated trade standard. Does not represent a verified active employer vacancy. Specific vacancies must be confirmed via employer listings on apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.
